currentRoundInspection.scope: Three useful exterior pictures and standard viewer PMTiles/DEM only;no bespoke survey sources or redistributed photographs.

pictures.observed: Inspected south entrance/upper church picture: off-white plaster masses,stepped basilica/clerestory with pointed windows,gray-brown metal roofs and tall west square clock tower. Bulbous lower roof,open lantern,smaller upper bulb and long tapered finial. South frontage has low connected ranges,central triangular pediment/tall pointed door,flank lancets and rectangular upper windows;east hip-roofed bay has paired rectangular windows. Relief/sculpture/lettering excluded.

Inspected clearer south entrance/tower view: dark window frames/wood door,pointed central entry and small flank lancets,upper rectangular paired windows,restrained pale pediment and hip-roofed eastern annex. Tower has small round-headed windows,circular dark clocks and arched cornice fields. Baroque lantern bays are open,with sparse rails and faceted paired bulbs.

Inspected aerial still explicitly labeled2023,from east toward western tower: dark gray standing-seam upper/side roofs,small choir roof lantern and brown/burgundy copper baroque spire with open lantern and round upper ornament. Roof/white masses fit mapped broad nave,narrow choir/apse,attached north/south ranges. Color reflects these inspected pictures;later restoration appearance is not independently verified.
